author: Atlas Digital Design LLC (https://atlasdigital.design)
description: Read-only MCP server for searching Angela Kamer's coastal and Southern house plans by bedrooms, square feet, lot width, pilings and elevator, with photos, current prices and lot-fit screening. Every result links to the plan page on intertwinehouseplans.com.
name: Intertwine House Plans: Plan Finder

tools.name: search_plans
tools.title: Search house plans
tools.description: Search Intertwine House Plans by the specs a buyer cares about: bedrooms, bathrooms, heated square feet, stories, width and depth, elevated or pilings foundation, elevator, drive-under garage, in-law suite, garage ADU, and style (beach, cottage, Low Country, carriage house). Returns matching plans with key specs, a photo, the current starting price (and sale price when one is running) and the plan's page.

maxWidthFt.description: Widest the house can be, in feet

elevated.description: Raised foundation (pilings, piers or elevated CMU), for flood zones and coastal lots

garageADU.description: Garage with an apartment or ADU

text.description: Words to match in the plan name or summary, like porch or courtyard

tools.name: get_plan
tools.title: Get one plan
tools.description: Everything about one plan, by name, other published name, or handle (for example The Heron or the-heron): specs, footprint, foundation options, garage, ceilings, roof pitch, framing, smallest lot it suits, photos and floor plans, every package with its current and regular price, the full design write-up, the study set link and price, how to request changes, and its page.

tools.name: plans_for_lot
tools.title: Plans that fit a lot
tools.description: Given a lot's width and depth in feet and its setbacks, returns the plans whose footprint fits the buildable area. A first screen only: confirm setbacks, flood zone and local rules with the jurisdiction and the designer.

tools.name: list_features
tools.title: List styles and features
tools.description: The styles and features plans are grouped by, with how many plans carry each.

tools.name: about_designer
tools.title: About the designer
tools.description: Who draws these plans, what plan sets come as, study sets, and how to ask for changes.

tools.name: buying_help
tools.title: Buying help
tools.description: Answers a buyer's questions before purchase: what a plan set includes, study sets, changing a plan, why there is no cost-to-build calculator and how to get a real number, plans that have been built (with photos), and the store's FAQ. Optionally pass words to match FAQ questions.

question.description: Words to match in the FAQ, like license or permit
